raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The NPU nightly pipeline switched the Moonlight GSM8K accuracy cases from evalscope to sgl_eval, which dropped measured scores from ~0.83 to ~0.73-0.82 because sgl_eval probes 0-shot with greedy decoding while the historical 0.83 baseline was calibrated with evalscope (4-shot chat, temperature 1.0). Forcing thresholds onto the sgl_eval scale loses the legacy calibration.

This PR adds a native `evalscope` backend to `NPUGSM8KMixin` so NPU accuracy cases can declare `gsm8k_backend = "evalscope"` and keep their historically calibrated thresholds.

## Modifications

* `NPUGSM8KMixin`: add `gsm8k_backend = "evalscope"` support via a new `_test_gsm8k_evalscope` method (delegates to the existing `run_evalscope` harness), expose the request concurrency as the overridable class attribute `gsm8k_eval_batch_size = 64`.
* Make the 1% accuracy tolerance idempotent: guard the threshold relaxation with a flag so outer retries (`run_suite --enable-retry`) cannot compound the 0.99 factor (0.83 -> 0.8217 -> 0.8134).
* Resolve the `run_evalscope.sh` install script relative to `__file__` instead of the stale `/root/sglang` hardcode (the CI image WORKDIR moved to `/sgl-workspace`).
* Require both the `pull_request` event and a non-nightly workflow ref for the PR smoke short-circuit, so PR-triggered nightly runs still execute the full accuracy cases.
* Point the two Moonlight cases (`TestDPAttentionMixedChunk`, `TestAscendMlaFiaHicacheBf16`) back to `gsm8k_accuracy_thres = 0.83` with `gsm8k_backend = "evalscope"`.

## Accuracy Tests

Validated on Ascend A3 (910B) in the nightly pipeline (run [39711641496](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39711641496)):

| Case | Measured | Relaxed threshold (0.83 x 0.99) | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| TestAscendMlaFiaHicacheBf16 (tp2, FIA+HiCache) | 0.8230 | 0.8217 | pass, first attempt |
| TestDPAttentionMixedChunk (tp2, dp2, mixed chunk) | 0.8260 | 0.8217 | pass, first attempt |

Both scores land within the historical evalscope fluctuation band of the 0.837 baseline; the previous sgl_eval runs measured only ~0.73-0.82.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Prettier](https://docs.sglang.ai/references/code_contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-prettier).
- [ ] Add test cases into the `test/` folder.
- [ ] Provide the documentation that corresponds to your changes.
- [ ] Update `docs/` documents if your change is significantly impactful.
- [ ] Seek review from reviewers.

## Review and Merge Process

Following the community PR review and merge process.

 _NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS = 3
 
-_is_pr_pipeline = os.environ.get("GITHUB_EVENT_NAME") == "pull_request"
+# Nightly is also PR-triggered, so exclude it by workflow ref; every other caller

+)
 
 
 def run_npu_pr_smoke(base_url):
@@ -42,20 +47,95 @@ def run_npu_pr_smoke(base_url):
 
 
 class NPUGSM8KMixin(GSM8KMixin):
-    """NPU GSM8K accuracy mixin — 1% tolerance + up to 3 retries."""
+    """NPU GSM8K accuracy mixin — 1% tolerance + up to 3 retries.
+
+    ``gsm8k_backend`` selects the harness:
+
+    * ``"run_eval"`` (default) / ``"sgl_eval"``: delegated to the parent.
+    * ``"evalscope"``: the NPU historical baseline harness (4-shot chat,
+      temperature 1.0). Use it to keep thresholds calibrated against the
+      legacy evalscope numbers (e.g. Moonlight bf16 tp2 = 0.837).
+    """
+
+    # evalscope request concurrency; 64 matches the harness the 0.83
+    # Moonlight baseline was calibrated with.
+    gsm8k_eval_batch_size = 64
+
+    def _test_gsm8k_evalscope(self, threshold):
+        from urllib.parse import urlparse
+
+        from sglang.test.ascend.e2e.test_npu_accuracy_utils import run_evalscope
+
+        parsed = urlparse(self.base_url)
+        # Match the historical evalscope baseline sampling: temperature 1.0
+        # with a generous token budget (gsm8k_max_tokens defaults to None).
+        generation_config = {
+            "temperature": (
+                self.gsm8k_temperature if self.gsm8k_temperature is not None else 1.0
+            ),
+            "max_tokens": self.gsm8k_max_tokens if self.gsm8k_max_tokens else 7168,
+        }
+        limit = (
+            self.gsm8k_num_examples if self.gsm8k_num_examples is not None else 100000
+        )
+        best = 0.0
+        for attempt in range(_NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS):
+            metrics = run_evalscope(
+                host=parsed.hostname,
+                port=parsed.port,
+                model=os.path.basename(self.model),
+                datasets=["gsm8k"],
+                limit=limit,
+                eval_batch_size=self.gsm8k_eval_batch_size,
+                generation_config=generation_config,
+            )
+            best = max(best, float(metrics.get("accuracy", 0.0)))
+            if best >= threshold:
+                print(f"gsm8k evalscope score={best:.4f} >= {threshold:.4f}")
+                return
+            if attempt < _NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS - 1:
+                print(
+                    f"[{type(self).__name__}] evalscope GSM8K attempt "
+                    f"{attempt + 1}/{_NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS} failed "
+                    f"(best={best:.4f} < {threshold:.4f}), retrying..."
+                )
+        raise AssertionError(
+            f"GSM8K evalscope accuracy {best} below threshold {threshold} "
+            f"after {_NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS} attempts"
+        )
+
+    def _resolve_relaxed_threshold(self) -> float:
+        """Return the GSM8K threshold with the NPU 1% tolerance applied.
+
+        ``gsm8k_score_threshold`` wins; the legacy ``gsm8k_accuracy_thres``
+        alias is used when it is unset (NaN). The relaxed value is cached, so
+        re-entering the test cannot compound the tolerance, and it is written
+        back to both attributes because the parent mixin reads it from there.
+        """
+        cached = getattr(self, "_npu_relaxed_threshold", None)
+        if cached is not None:
+            return cached
 
-    def test_gsm8k(self):
-        if _is_pr_pipeline:
-            run_npu_pr_smoke(self.base_url)
-            return
         threshold = self.gsm8k_score_threshold
-        if threshold != threshold:  # NaN → legacy alias
+        if math.isnan(threshold):  # canonical knob unset -> legacy alias
             threshold = self.gsm8k_accuracy_thres
         relaxed = threshold * _NPU_ACCURACY_TOLERANCE
 
-        # Patch both so the parent picks up the relaxed threshold.
         self.gsm8k_score_threshold = relaxed
         self.gsm8k_accuracy_thres = relaxed
+        self._npu_relaxed_threshold = relaxed
+        return relaxed
+
+    def test_gsm8k(self):
+        if _is_pr_pipeline:
+            run_npu_pr_smoke(self.base_url)
+            return
+
+        relaxed = self._resolve_relaxed_threshold()
+
+        if self.gsm8k_backend == "evalscope":
+            self._test_gsm8k_evalscope(relaxed)
+            return
 
         for attempt in range(_NPU_MAX_ACCURACY_ATTEMPTS):
             try:
